polaris: Can I_phi be pre-registered from input-side spectroscopy, structure, and dephasing variables independently of bulk superconducting output, or is it a posterior relabeling of output?
framework: Input-output separation in layered-superconductor spectroscopy: construct a dimensionless input-side readiness index only from normal-state or pre-declared structural/spectroscopic variables, then test it against withheld bulk superconducting outputs.
findings: Round 1 finds strong prior-art overlap for every physical ingredient of I_phi: interlayer coherence, Ni dz2/apical-O/bilayer coupling, c-axis optical spectral weight, density-wave competition, oxygen-vacancy disorder, and pressure/structure tuning are all already active explanations in bilayer/Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates. I did not find a clearly identical prior protocol in which a single I_phi-like input-side index is fully specified before inspecting Tc, zero resistance, shielding, Meissner response, critical current, or bulk phase stiffness. Therefore the possible novelty is narrow and methodological: a leakage-controlled pre-registration protocol, not a new mechanism. The fatal risk is that C_phi and E_floor are easy to define only after seeing the superconducting phase boundary; if either is calibrated on bulk output, S1 fails.

core_answer.non_circular_measurability: Partially possible in principle, not validated. E_z2 can be pre-registered from ARPES/XAS/RIXS/DFT-informed dz2 spectral-weight proxies or c-axis optical sum-rule proxies; Gamma_phi can be estimated from normal-state optical Drude scattering, Raman/NMR dephasing, or linewidths; E_floor can be a pre-declared disorder/structure penalty from apical-O vacancy metrics, mosaic/strain width, or residual normal-state scattering. C_phi is the hardest variable because many natural definitions collapse into superconducting output, especially Josephson plasma, superfluid density, phase stiffness, Meissner screening, or zero-resistance coherence.
core_answer.posterior_relabeling_risk: High unless thresholds, weights, spectral windows, temperature/pressure points, and missing-data rules are frozen before any bulk superconducting output is inspected.
core_answer.prior_art_overlap: High on mechanism; moderate on input observables; no exact I_phi protocol found in MCP searches.

prior_art_overlap.topic: interlayer coherence and dz2-pz-dz2 or dz2-driven bilayer coupling
prior_art_overlap.implication: Not a novelty claim for LP28-S1; only the non-circular protocol can be novel.

prior_art_overlap.topic: c-axis optical spectral weight and Drude/scattering decomposition
prior_art_overlap.overlap_level: high in layered superconductors, partial in nickelates
prior_art_overlap.implication: Can supply input variables but not a unique I_phi validation.
DW disappearance cannot be used as sufficient evidence for bulk superconductivity and should not be folded into I_phi as an output proxy.

prior_art_overlap.topic: structure, pressure, apical oxygen vacancies, and oxygen stoichiometry
prior_art_overlap.implication: Good candidates for E_floor, but also likely confounders that can mimic predictive success.

fatal_circularity_risks: Choosing I_phi threshold after viewing Tc, zero resistance, shielding, Meissner signal, critical current, or phase stiffness.
Using Josephson plasma resonance, superfluid density, or condensate spectral weight as C_phi.
Defining Gamma_phi from superconducting fluctuation fits that already encode transition behavior.
Tuning E_floor to repair false positives/false negatives in the known phase diagram.
Selecting spectral windows or pressure/temperature points because they maximize correlation with superconducting output.
Training weights on samples labeled superconducting/non-superconducting and then calling the result input-side.

steps: Before measuring or revealing bulk output, declare sample set, pressure/strain/temperature grid, spectral windows, orbital-projection method, and missing-data rules.
Measure input-side structure: apical-O geometry, oxygen vacancy/disorder proxy, lattice/strain linewidths, phase purity, and stacking polymorph flags.
Measure input-side spectroscopy: ARPES/XAS/RIXS dz2 proxy where available and normal-state c-axis optical conductivity in a fixed frequency window.
Compute E_z2, C_phi, Gamma_phi, and E_floor using frozen formulas and coefficients not trained on superconducting output.
Timestamp each sample's I_phi before opening the bulk-output file.
Only then compare to pre-declared binary/continuous output endpoints such as Tc, zero resistance, shielding, or Meissner response; these endpoints are evaluation-only.
pre_registration_protocol_candidate.go_no_go_test: S1 survives Round 1 only if at least one lab-feasible route can compute all four variables without using bulk output. It fails if C_phi or E_floor cannot be specified except by fitting known superconducting boundaries.

weakest_link: C_phi. A normal-state c-axis Drude/coherent fraction is the least circular candidate, but it may be experimentally hard in nickelates and may still be a generic interlayer-coherence relabel unless the exact window and decomposition are frozen before output labels are inspected.
next_plan: Round 2 should narrow to one concrete measurement stack: same-sample structure plus normal-state c-axis optical/ARPES proxy under a fixed pressure or strain path. The main task is to decide whether C_phi can be derived from normal-state spectral decomposition with no Josephson/superfluid leakage, and whether E_floor coefficients can be externally fixed from disorder/structure rather than output fitting.
literature_needed: full text and figures for PRL 136, 216501 (2026), especially c-axis conductivity and DW/layer-decoupling measurements
full text for DOI 10.1103/466c-8sl4 on 3D electronic structures in superconducting bilayer RP nickelate films
nickelate c-axis optical conductivity raw or supplemental data
ARPES/XAS/RIXS orbital-resolved dz2 spectral weight in La3Ni2O7 or ambient-pressure bilayer films
normal-state scattering/dephasing measurements under pressure that are not fit to superconducting transition endpoints
structural/apical oxygen vacancy quantification with sample-resolved output held out

deepening_1.next_consequence: If I_phi can be computed input-side, it becomes a leakage test for phase-bus readiness rather than a proof of superconductivity.
deepening_1.second_consequence: False positives would be scientifically useful: they would separate interlayer phase-bus readiness from pairing amplitude, disorder percolation, or sample inhomogeneity.

deepening_2.most_fragile_assumption: That normal-state c-axis coherence is a valid C_phi proxy rather than just another transport observable already entangled with the eventual bulk transition.
deepening_2.second_consequence: If this assumption fails, I_phi reduces to known interlayer-coherence language and S1 has no independent methodological content.
